{{Top|leg}}
'''Ellylyn''' was a [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Ellylyn carried [[Neuronic whip/Legends|neuronic whip]] while overseeing [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and saw it as a symbol of authority. When Ellylyn put it down for a moment, a runaway attempted to shoot the slaver. Ellylyn related the story to [[Lowwel]] on the entry for the neuronic whip in Gundark's Gear Datalog when Lowwel stated that the whip was a cruel weapon and the users were evil.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
